capabilities: Sign in to a Caspee brain from the settings
Pick vault folders whose notes are sent
Send changed notes at startup and about 30 seconds after edits
Skip excluded files and notes over 2 MB
Sign out and revoke this device's token
extras: One way only: the plugin never writes into the vault. Attachments, Excalidraw drawings, hidden folders, .trash, templates and sync conflict copies are never sent, and notes over 2 MB are skipped. The sign-in token is kept in Obsidian's secret storage rather than data.json; no telemetry or ads.
problem: Notes kept in an Obsidian vault are not visible to a team or its agents in Caspee unless someone copies them out by hand.

relations.evidence: Sends the notes of the folders you pick to your Caspee brain

summary: One-way uploader that sends the Markdown notes in folders you pick to a Caspee brain, so a team and its agents can read them with sources.
